description: What the command broker's suite must notice: the request checks (path, arguments, environment, working directory), the limits (queue, output, run time), the clean-up after a command and the stuck state, the socket's owner and mode, and the reaper's reach. Run on Linux as an ordinary user: K25 (the reaper refusing the broker's own uid) cannot be told from its absence as root, whose uid 0 is refused by the line before it.

mutations.name: K01-dotdot
mutations.what: a program path with '..' is accepted

mutations.name: K02-args-count
mutations.what: any number of arguments is accepted

mutations.name: K03-arg-size
mutations.what: an argument of any size is accepted

mutations.name: K04-args-total
mutations.what: the total size of the arguments is not limited

mutations.name: K05-env-name
mutations.what: any environment variable name is accepted

mutations.name: K06-env-bytes
mutations.what: the environment size is not limited

mutations.name: K07-identity-env
mutations.what: the caller decides HOME, USER and LOGNAME

patches.old: Object.assign(env, { HOME: agent.home, USER: agent.name, LOGNAME: agent.name });

mutations.name: K08-cwd-roots
mutations.what: a working directory outside the allowed areas is accepted

patches.old: if (!cwdRoots.some((root) => cwd === root || cwd.startsWith(root + path.sep))) throw requestError('cwd_denied'

mutations.name: K09-cwd-sibling
mutations.what: a sibling folder whose name starts like the root is accepted

mutations.name: K10-cwd-link
mutations.what: the working directory is not resolved before it is checked

mutations.name: K11-queue
mutations.what: the queue has no limit

mutations.name: K12-duplicate-id
mutations.what: a request id can be used twice at once

patches.old: if (connection.runs.has(id)) { send(connection, { t: 'error', id, code: 'bad_request', message: 'Duplicate request id.' }); return; }

mutations.name: K13-output-limit
mutations.what: output is not limited

mutations.name: K14-timeout
mutations.what: a command can run for ever

mutations.name: K15-reap-after
mutations.what: what a command leaves behind is not stopped

mutations.name: K16-stuck
mutations.what: a failed reap does not block the next command

patches.old:
stuck = String(error.message);
      log(`Không dọn sạch được tiến trình của agent: ${stuck}`);
patches.new:
stuck = null;
      log(`Không dọn sạch được tiến trình của agent: ${error.message}`);

mutations.name: K17-stuck-retry
mutations.what: a stuck broker never retries the reap

mutations.name: K18-umask
mutations.what: the broker does not set the umask for the commands

patches.old: const previousUmask = umask === null ? null : process.umask(umask);

mutations.name: K19-socket-mode
mutations.what: the socket is left with the default mode

mutations.name: K21-leftover-socket
mutations.what: a file that is not a socket is deleted at the socket's path

patches.old: if (!existing.isSocket()) throw new Error(`${socketPath} exists and is not a socket`);

mutations.name: K22-disconnect
mutations.what: a command keeps running when its connection goes away

mutations.name: K23-signal-list
mutations.what: any signal name is passed on

mutations.name: K24-line-limit
mutations.what: a request line of any size is buffered

mutations.name: K25-reap-own-uid
mutations.what: the reaper accepts the broker's own uid

mutations.name: K26-reap-saved-uid
mutations.what: the reaper only looks at the real uid
